REFERENCE 1 = the liked WONI-reference BARE-ABS heroine: preserve this same slim adult face, eye/nose/lip shape and compact natural body; do not put her into covered-abdomen outfit.
REFERENCE 2 = the two-character layout/role reference. Keep the LEFT heroine and RIGHT original Spearmage visually different. Use the RIGHT woman's original pretty compact face with amber eyes, higher arched brows and soft narrow jaw, NOT the Woni face. Do not copy reference 2's held polearm.

LEFT: adult woman in twenties, Woni-reference slender face and calm confident gaze, compact agile natural 6.8-7 heads, high-neck navy-black cropped fitted leather protective bodice covers chest, EXPOSED TONED ABS AND WAIST, full-length fitted trousers cover BOTH thighs, short asymmetric navy shoulder mantle and lowered hood, quiet worn dark-steel guards and practical flat boots. Original oversized dark sculptural LEFT forearm gauntlet (VIEWER'S RIGHT arm) with EXACTLY ONE blue embedded core and a few blue seams; no other glowing core. Other forearm in simple wraps. Keep arms away from abdomen, clear hands. Strong large clothing shapes, controlled material highlights, no long trailing cape or excessive chains/gold trim.

RIGHT: another beautiful ADULT woman with a distinct original amber-eyed face, compact feminine natural proportions, no tall elongated amazon, approximately same height as left. Continuous charcoal worn-metal fitted cuirass covers ENTIRE abdomen to hips; tasteful naturally shaped upper-chest neckline, short plum split hip cloth over opaque fitted shorts, ONE exposed upper thigh, other leg more covered; short cloth only, no floor gown. Slim articulated guards and practical flat boots. Bare abs belong ONLY to left. Both hands natural and relaxed, not frozen in a grip holding an invisible item. Keep the grounded quiet-ready stance, no hand-on-hip fashion pose, no crossed legs, no beauty-photo smile. No celebrity identity on the right.

Both fully visible from hair crown to soles, same neutral eye-level camera and shared ground, believable same game-world style, worn leather/metal, deep quiet values, pleasing adult anatomy, not glossy plastic dolls or idol promo. Pale studio key-art background with small natural contact shadows. Two visibly DIFFERENT hair silhouettes and color directions per the set. No third person, no held staff/spear/sword/gun, no captions, no logo, no watermark. EXTRA generous top/bottom margins, figures occupy only 75% of canvas height. Hairstyle changes must not broaden faces, swap roles or hide abdomen.

SET-SPECIFIC HAIRSTYLES: LEFT has a NEW long black-brown HALF-UP TWISTED HIGH KNOT, lower hair remains loose to upper waist, two narrow temple braids join the small crown knot, long natural face-framing side pieces, beautiful large coherent locks, practical dark leather tie, no silver hair. RIGHT has a NEW short neck/jaw-length asymmetric angled BOB in almost-black SMOKY PLUM, long side-swept fringe reveals eyebrows and both amber eyes, one temple cleanly tucked/tightly braided behind ear, distinct compact swept blade silhouette, no ponytail or silver color.

history.prompt:
Create ONE premium dark-fantasy game-character key-art plate with TWO distinct ADULT female heroes, FULL BODY, equal ground line and approximately equal compact natural 6.8-7-head proportions. Neither should become a towering long-legged amazon. Reference 1 = WONI-reference BARE-ABS heroine identity, do not put her in the covered-abdomen Spearmage costume. Reference 2 = Spearmage compact body/cuirass/thigh role only; she must have a DIFFERENT original adult face from Woni. Reference 3 = approved MAGIC SPEAR DESIGN SET, explicitly use the requested column, do not revert to old plain ring-on-stick. Reference 4 = straight-metal AXIS GUIDE ONLY, not appearance.

LEFT / BARE-ABS TRANSFORMATION HEROINE: retain the liked slim Woni-reference illustrated facial proportions, eye/nose/lip shape and dark-haired Asian young-adult identity from reference 1. Focused composed face, not idol promo smile. A high-neck cropped navy-black LEATHER chest garment fully covers chest and exposes athletic ABS and WAIST from ribs to belt. Natural center abdominal line and toned obliques, not exaggerated bodybuilder. Both legs COVERED in fitted full-length dark trousers, flat practical armored boots. Short asymmetric navy shoulder mantle with hood DOWN so hairstyle visible, a few quiet metal guards, restrained buckles rather than endless gold filigree, no giant tattered cape. On HER LEFT forearm (= VIEWER'S RIGHT) exactly ONE blue-core CLAW GAUNTLET, rigid sculptural talon plates and narrow cobalt seams, no extra core anywhere. Arms slightly apart from torso, abdomen visible. No spear, bow or sword for her.

RIGHT / SPEARMAGE: a different original beautiful ADULT woman in late twenties, compact feminine build, softly tapered narrow oval face with modest cheekbone width, distinctly longer UPSLANTED amber eyes, defined arched brows, refined medium nose with a clear bridge and thinner defined upper lip; no broad cheeks, long severe face or large squared jaw. NOT Woni's face pasted onto both. Calm alert confidence. A continuous fitted CHARCOAL worn-steel cuirass covers entire abdomen to hips, tasteful upper-chest shaped neckline, opaque chest protection. One short deep-PLUM hip cloth arrangement over opaque fitted shorts with ONE upper-thigh side opening, other leg more covered; no bare abs, no floor-length gown. Smooth controlled plate groups and leather joints, flat practical greaves/boots. Hold ONE approved magical spear fully upright near the OUTSIDE RIGHT EDGE of her column. The tip, spearhead center, magical center, shaft and butt share ONE ruler-straight vertical axis, regular concentric pieces, stable parallel shaft edges, natural hand gripping around that axis. One hand holds it, free arm relaxed ready beside hip. Do not deform spear to fit pose. Head large enough to retain the approved fantastical silhouette. No cropping any part.

Both outfits and materials belong to the actual project's warrior-style world: tactile worn matte leather/blackened steel, strong value masses, face/hand focus, grounded contact and a credible calm ready stance. Keep navy/blue versus charcoal/plum identity, not identical costumes recolored. Attractive adult faces with restrained makeup and human skin, no generic glossy doll, no explicit nudity, no glamour leg-cross pose, no exaggerated chest/anatomy. Two distinct hair silhouettes and poses but retain each character's role and face. Pale neutral key-art backdrop, subtle small contact shadows, no setting/other characters, no text, logos or watermark.

FRAMING: an extra WIDE landscape plate, two equal roomy columns, the entire upright spear must fit inside canvas. All heads, hairstyles, both sets of boots, cloth and spear ends are comfortably visible with a full palm-width clear margin top/bottom. Draw figure/spear no more than 80% of image height, not tight edge framing.

RIGID METAL WEAPON GEOMETRY — HARD CONSTRAINT:
All metal parts are rigid solids. Preserve the approved straight axes, fixed designed curves, cross-sections and assembly. A straight shaft/blade spine/receiver-barrel axis must remain ruler-straight from end to end. The two silhouette edges of a cylindrical shaft remain parallel except for an explicitly designed taper. The weapon tip, head center, shaft, grip segments and pommel/butt must be collinear whenever the design specifies one axis. Continue the SAME centerline and tangent behind every occluding hand; hands wrap around the existing rigid object and do not bend, pinch, offset or reshape it. Head, rings, collars and end fittings attach concentrically on that axis. Circular parts remain regular circles or coherent perspective ellipses. Use one consistent perspective for the whole object. Preserve intentional fixed bow/saber curves exactly; do not invent elastic deformation. If the pose conflicts with rigid geometry, adjust the hands/arms/pose instead of deforming the weapon. Keep every metal edge crisp and structurally continuous. Full weapon endpoints inside frame.

NEGATIVE: rubbery metal, flexible shaft, bending at grips, bowed or banana-shaped straight components, S-curves, kinks, melted or sagging steel, wavy barrel/blade edges, bulging or pinched tubing, offset sections, misaligned tip and shaft, off-center concentric rings, inconsistent perspective, disconnected fittings, motion-warped metal.
Set-specific hairstyle and spear selection: LEFT has a NEW long black-brown HALF-UP TWISTED HIGH KNOT, lower hair remains loose to upper waist, two narrow temple braids join the small crown knot, long natural face-framing side pieces, beautiful large coherent locks, practical dark leather tie, no silver hair. RIGHT has a NEW short neck/jaw-length asymmetric angled BOB in almost-black SMOKY PLUM, long side-swept fringe reveals eyebrows and both amber eyes, one temple cleanly tucked/tightly braided behind ear, distinct compact swept blade silhouette, no ponytail or silver color. Spearmage uses LEFT COLUMN of reference 3: VOID RIFT, broad black split spearblade with vertical violet fissure and open annular iris. Preserve its distinctive head architecture, not old clock-disc.
